evidence: In the heart of Hanoi's capital, the National Museum of History's exhibition space for modern history and revolution stands majestically on Trần Quang Khải street, its vaulted ceiling soaring above the vibrant red of the flags and the faded, tattered yellow of historical artifacts. This sacred area, a testament to the nation's resilient spirit, was established to preserve the weighty legacy of the revolution, from the darkest night of slavery to the dawn of independence and freedom.
